sectionHeadings: 033: Qualify a three-voter topology on Kubernetes before anyone calls it supported
B-1. N=3 stays unsupported until its evidence exists
B-2. A real-node harness, separate from the in-process suite
B-3. Node 1 initializes only on positive evidence that the cluster is fresh
B-4. The pre-shutdown delay is a node option
B-5. The log-revert relaxation is a recorded decision
B-6. The acceptance is deterministic and named by scenario
record.summary: Proposes, for owner decision, how this fork would qualify a three-voter topology for the Statecraft cell on Kubernetes while N=1 stays supported and stays the Aicortex local profile. Owns the architecture and migration proposal and the reconciliation handoff to Rahi, records eight findings established from source (F-118 to F-125), and specifies the hiqlite-side repairs, the real-node harness and the deterministic acceptance that stand between today and any claim of N=3 support. Records the owner's decision D-14: at N=3 the cell is two StatefulSets, one hiqlite node per pod, and the single-container composition stays the N=1 profile. It changes no code, supports nothing, and claims no consumer territory.
record.title: Qualify a three-voter topology on Kubernetes before anyone calls it supported
